name: cohesive
description: A chat ends. The work doesn't. With Cohesive connected, what the agent makes lands in your workspace as a canvas, a file, or an automation that runs on its own schedule. Open it later, edit it, and pick up where you left off. Every call runs as you and sees only what you can.

interface.longDescription: A chat ends. The work doesn't. With Cohesive connected, what the agent makes lands in your workspace as a canvas, a file, or an automation that runs on its own schedule. Open it later, edit it, and pick up where you left off. Every call runs as you and sees only what you can.
defaultPrompt: Turn this conversation into a canvas in my Cohesive workspace.
Every Monday at 9am, summarize last week's new files in my workspace.

positive.description: Find a canvas by name and show it
positive.prompt: Show me my "Product roadmap" canvas in Cohesive.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Product roadmap canvas and shows it as an interactive board in the conversation.

positive.prompt: Create a Cohesive canvas in my Demo workspace called "Launch plan" with three notes: goals, risks, and timeline. Then show it to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Launch plan canvas with three laid-out notes and shows the finished board.

positive.prompt: Show me the files in my Cohesive Demo workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's files as a grid of previews; picking one opens it in place.

positive.prompt: Write a one-page launch checklist and save it to my Cohesive Demo workspace as launch-checklist.md.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves launch-checklist.md in the Demo workspace and returns a link that opens it in Cohesive.

positive.prompt: Set up a Cohesive automation on my Demo workspace that runs every Monday at 9am Pacific and summarizes the files added that week.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a weekly automation on the Demo workspace with a Monday 09:00 America/Los_Angeles schedule and self-contained instructions.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
Book me a flight from San Francisco to New York next Friday.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: workspace, canvas, file, and automation tools, plus the cohesive skill.
